evidence.title: Let the Bullets Fly: Multimodal Fake News Detection with Temporal-Aligned Generative Danmaku

summary: A new study proposes a method using temporally aligned generative danmaku (bullet comments) to improve the detection of fake news across multimodal content. The approach leverages real-time user interactions to enhance accuracy in identifying misleading information.
title: Researchers Introduce Temporal-Aligned Generative Danmaku for Multimodal Fake News Detection
